Minion.note: Goes on the Minion whose character the Investigator learns.

Wrong.note: Goes on the second shown player, who is not that Minion.

reminders.label: Minion
reminders.text: Choose a Minion to show the Investigator: put [Minion] on them
reminders.reason: Marks the Minion the Investigator learns about

reminders.label: Wrong
reminders.text: Choose a player: put [Wrong] on them
reminders.reason: Marks the second player the Investigator is shown
